explanation: erdosproblems.com/503: in ℝ² the largest set in which every three points form an isosceles triangle has size 6 (Kelly; Kovács). The Lean statement says 6 is the greatest ncard of a set A ⊆ ℝ² with A.IsIsosceles (nonempty, and every triple of distinct points has two equal distances). Infinite sets have ncard 0 but cannot occur anyway (any isosceles set is finite by the Blokhuis bound applied to its finite subsets), so IsGreatest captures the maximum. Faithful.
